basic_details.job_title: CMHO Janjgir-Champa Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Offline for 117 Nursing Officer, ANM & Other Posts
basic_details.post_name: Nursing Officer, Laboratory Technician, OT Technician and other posts

application_fee.details: The application fee must be paid via Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favor of "DISTRICT HEALTH SOCIETY Non NHM Other Fund Janjgir" payable at Janjgir. The DD must be attached with the application form.

age_limit.details: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for management posts, calculated as of 01 January 2026.

qualification.details: Candidates must be native residents of Chhattisgarh.

selection_process: The selection process involves marks awarded based on educational qualification percentage
how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification PDF from the official website.
Fill out the application form with correct details.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all mandatory educational and experience documents.
Enclose the original Demand Draft for the required application fee.
Place the application and documents inside an envelope specifying the post name and category.
Send the application via Registered Post or Speed Post to the office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District Janjgir-Champa (Chhattisgarh) on or before 23 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date or through unauthorized modes will be rejected. Candidates must be native residents of Chhattisgarh and submit a valid domicile certificate. Separate applications and fees must be submitted if applying for more than one post. Incomplete applications or those with errors will be summarily rejected. Experience points will be counted only for work done in government, semi-government, or state-funded institutions under NHM.

content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Chief Medical and Health Office Janjgir-Champa (CMHO Janjgir-Champa) Which posts? Nursing Officer, Laboratory Technician, OT Technician, Physiotherapist, Dental Surgeon, RMA, MO- AYUSH, ANM, Pharmacist, Staff Nurse, Community Health Officer, Feeding Demonstrator and other posts How many vacancies? 117 Vacancies Who can apply? content_sections.text: Candidates must be native residents of Chhattisgarh.

PG Degree/ Diploma in psychology/ Counselling/ health Education/ Mass Communication/ Social Science.

faq.answer: A total of 117 vacancies are available across various healthcare and administrative posts.

faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for management posts as of 01 January 2026.

faq.answer: The application fee must be paid through a Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favor of DISTRICT HEALTH SOCIETY Non NHM Other Fund Janjgir.
